title: A Study to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy of Efimosfermin Alfa Compared with Placebo in Adult Participants with ALD
official: A Dose-finding, Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Phase 2 Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Treatment with Efimosfermin Alfa in Adult Participants with Alcohol-related Liver Disease (ALD)
summary:
Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of efimosfermin on the reduction from baseline in VCTE- LSM in participants with ALD

To evaluate the efficacy of efimosfermin on the reduction from baseline in VCTE- LSM and/or MELD score in participants with ALD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be 18 to 75 years of age inclusive, at the time of Screening. INC#1
2. Capable of giving signed informed consent prior to the performance of any study-specific procedures. INC#2
3. Able and willing to comply with all study assessments and adhere to the protocol schedule of activities (SoA). INC#3
4. A female participant is eligible to participate if they are not pregnant or  breastfeeding, and one of the following conditions applies:   - Is a PONCBP as defined in Section 10.4.1.2.   OR  - Is a POCBP and using a contraceptive method that is highly effective, with a  failure rate of <1%, as described in Section 10.4, 30 days prior to and during the study intervention period and after the last dose of study  intervention. The investigator should evaluate the potential for contraceptive  method failure (e.g., noncompliance, recently initiated in relationship to the first dose of study intervention).   ▪ A POCBP must have a negative highly sensitive pregnancy test ([urine or serum] as required by local regulations) immediately prior to randomization and before the first dose of study intervention (See  Section 8.3.5 for Pregnancy Testing).   ▪ Additional requirements for pregnancy testing during and after the study intervention are located in Section 8.3.5.   ▪ The investigator is responsible for review of medical history, menstrual history, and recent sexual activity to decrease the risk for inclusion of a person with an early undetected pregnancy. INC#7
Exclusion criteria:
1. Evidence of Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome or alcohol-related dementia. EXC#18
2. High HbA1c. EXC#38
3. High ALT. EXC#39
4. Other primary causes of liver disease (e.g., viral hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis, autoimmune hepatitis, drug-induced hepatotoxicity, Wilson disease, hemochromatosis, alpha-1-antitryspin deficiency, etc.). ALD must be the primary cause of liver disease. EXC#2
5. High ALP. EXC#40
6. Co-infection with HBV, HCV, or HIV. EXC#3
7. History of diabetes mellitus (DM), either:   o Type 1 DM   o Type 2 DM with unstable glycemic control or with major complications.  EXC#5
8. Current, or history of known hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). EXC#10
9. Low Serum albumin. EXC#41
10. High INR. EXC#42
11. History of drug abuse within the 12 months prior to Day 1 or evidence of such abuse as indicated by laboratory assays conducted at Screening. EXC#43
12. Concomitant use of investigational drugs for MASH or ALD. EXC#27
13. History of hypersensitivity (such as anaphylaxis or hepatotoxicity) to study intervention and/or its excipients, drugs of similar biological class, FGF21 protein analogs, Fc-fusion proteins, or other protein-based therapeutics. EXC#45
14. Overt hepatic encephalopathy (West Haven grade ≥2). EXC#47
15. History of malignancy of any organ system (other than localized basal cell carcinoma of the skin or in situ cervical cancer), treated or untreated, within the 3 years prior to Screening 1, regardless of any evidence of local recurrence or metastasis. EXC#9
16. Prior use of an FGF21 analogue, including efimosfermin, within the 6 months prior to Screening 1. EXC#21
17. Individuals with a history of resmetirom use within 3 months prior to Day 1 are to be excluded. EXC#24
18. Any major surgery within 3 months prior to Screening 1 or planned during the study EXC#11
19. Any surgical or medical condition that might jeopardize the individual’s safety or compliance with study procedures in the opinion of the investigator. EXC#12
20. All organ transplant recipients, except for history of corneal transplants, or current listing or active consideration for liver transplant during the Screening period. EXC#13   Note: Participants under active consideration for liver transplant may be considered for the study upon discussion with the medical monitor.
21. Poorly controlled hypertension. EXC#16
22. Current or planned participation in any clinical trial of investigational therapies or medical devices. EXC#31
23. High urinary albumin to creatinine ratio (uACR). EXC#36
24. High Triglycerides. EXC#37
